# Commands

<!-- Generated by tests/TextTools.Core.Tests/CommandsDocTests.cs from Commands.All. Do not edit by hand. -->

Select text in a PL/SQL Developer editor and pick a command under **Plug-Ins**. Without a selection a command applies to the whole text; "Now" commands insert at the cursor.
SQL Tools do not change the editor: the result goes to the clipboard (without a selection: the statement under the cursor).
Lines are separated by `⏎` in the examples below.

## String Tools

### Case

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| camelCase | `first_name` | `firstName` |
| PascalCase | `first_name` | `FirstName` |
| snake_case | `firstName` | `first_name` |
| UPPER_SNAKE_CASE | `firstName` | `FIRST_NAME` |
| kebab-case | `firstName` | `first-name` |

### SQL

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escape quotes ( ' -> '' ) | `it's` | `it''s` |
| Unescape quotes ( '' -> ' ) | `'it''s'` | `it's` |
| Wrap in q'...' (alt quoting) | `it's` | `q'[it's]'` |
| List -> IN (...) | `42, O'Neil` | `IN ('42', 'O''Neil')` |
| Lines -> 'a' \|\| chr(10) \|\| 'b' | `Dear ⏎ it's ok` | `'Dear' \|\| chr(10) \|\| ⏎ 'it''s ok'` |

### Encode

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Base64 encode | `Hello` | `SGVsbG8=` |
| Base64 decode | `SGVsbG8=` | `Hello` |
| URL encode | `a b&c` | `a%20b%26c` |
| URL decode | `a%20b%26c` | `a b&c` |
| HEX encode (UTF-8) | `Hi` | `4869` |
| HEX decode (UTF-8) | `4869` | `Hi` |

### Lines

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Sort A-Z | `b ⏎ C ⏎ a` | `C ⏎ a ⏎ b` |
| Sort Z-A | `b ⏎ C ⏎ a` | `b ⏎ a ⏎ C` |
| Sort A-Z, ignore case | `b ⏎ C ⏎ a` | `a ⏎ b ⏎ C` |
| Reverse | `1 ⏎ 2 ⏎ 3` | `3 ⏎ 2 ⏎ 1` |
| Remove duplicates | `a ⏎ b ⏎ a` | `a ⏎ b` |
| Remove empty lines | `a ⏎  ⏎ b` | `a ⏎ b` |
| Trim trailing spaces | `a    ⏎ b  ` | `a ⏎ b` |
| Align by := | `l_id := 1; ⏎ l_name := 'x';` | `l_id   := 1; ⏎ l_name := 'x';` |
| Align by => | `p_id => 1, ⏎ p_name => 'x'` | `p_id   => 1, ⏎ p_name => 'x'` |

## Date Tools

### Now

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Now: DATE '2026-10-13' | (cursor position) | `DATE '2026-10-13'` |
| Now: TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 14:30:00' | (cursor position) | `TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 14:30:00'` |
| Now: TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 14:30:00.123456' | (cursor position) | `TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 14:30:00.123456'` |
| Now: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE | (cursor position) | `TIMESTAMP '2026-10-13 14:30:00.123456 -03:00'` |
| Now: TO_DATE('2026-10-13 14:30:00', ...) | (cursor position) | `TO_DATE('2026-10-13 14:30:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')` |
| Now: ISO 8601 (2026-10-13T14:30:00-03:00) | (cursor position) | `2026-10-13T14:30:00-03:00` |
| Now: Unix epoch (seconds) | (cursor position) | `1791912600` |

### Convert

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Epoch -> TIMESTAMP (UTC) | `1760356800` | `TIMESTAMP '2025-10-13 12:00:00'` |
| Date -> Unix epoch (UTC if no offset) | `2025-10-13 12:00:00` | `1760356800` |
| Date -> TO_DATE(...) | `13.10.2026 14:30` | `TO_DATE('2026-10-13 14:30:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')` |
| Date -> DATE / TIMESTAMP literal | `13.10.2026` | `DATE '2026-10-13'` |

### Masks

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Java/.NET mask -> Oracle mask | `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` | `YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS` |
| Oracle mask -> Java mask | `YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS` | `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` |
| Oracle mask -> .NET mask | `DD.MM.YYYY HH24:MI:SS.FF3` | `dd.MM.yyyy HH:mm:ss.fff` |
| ISO duration -> INTERVAL | `PT1H30M` | `INTERVAL '1:30' HOUR TO MINUTE` |

## SQL Tools

### Copy

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Copy SQL with constants resolved | `declare ⏎   c_new constant varchar2(3) := 'NEW'; ⏎   l_cnt number; ⏎ begin ⏎   select count(*) into l_cnt from orders where status = c_new; ⏎ end;` | `select count(*) from orders where status = 'NEW' /*c_new*/` |
| Explain Plan with constants | (statement under the cursor) | `the IDE Plan Window with this statement, constants resolved` |
| Extended Explain Plan | (statement under the cursor) | `an HTML window: Plan (reading order, step panels), Findings (static rules), Text (DBMS_XPLAN + Copy), Reference` |

## Format Tools

### Rules

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Apply formatting rules | `PROCEDURE p IS ⏎   v_a t.a%type; ⏎ BEGIN ⏎   v_long_name:=nvl(i_x,0); ⏎   v_b:=1; ⏎ END;` | `PROCEDURE p IS ⏎   v_a t.a%TYPE; ⏎ BEGIN ⏎   v_long_name := NVL(i_x,0); ⏎   v_b         := 1; ⏎ END p;` |

### Settings

| Command | Example input | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Settings | (none) | `the settings window of the formatting rules (tabs, checkboxes, before/after preview)` |
